state.question: For Elmhaul, what do the latest records show about truck empty running? Please resolve this specific point: September empty vehicle kilometres as a share of total kilometres compared with August.
state.gap: September empty vehicle kilometres as a share of total kilometres compared with August.

candidates.title: Elmhaul: the measurement desk
candidates.abstract: Elmhaul features in a field guide to truck empty running. The worked example draws on a separate setting: a sports page uses empty running to describe a training drill.

candidates.title: Elmhaul: the operating record
candidates.abstract: Elmhaul fleet telematics ledger supports a dated assessment of september empty vehicle kilometres as a share of total kilometres compared with August.

candidates.title: Elmhaul: the weekly notebook
candidates.abstract: An edited digest of Alma King's Dispatch's dispatch on Elmhaul, retaining its reported comparison and attribution.

candidates.title: Elmhaul: the latest field dispatch
candidates.abstract: Our reporting desk follows Elmhaul, drawing on an independent correspondent's account of september empty vehicle kilometres as a share of total kilometres compared with August.

candidates.title: Elmhaul: the strategic argument
candidates.abstract: I set out the case for Elmhaul's strategy in truck empty running, using incentives and managerial judgement to project the next stage.

candidates.title: Elmhaul: what the announcement changes
candidates.abstract: A commentary revisiting Elmhaul's operating announcement, carrying the same factual account as the public record.
